description: The Paseo Bellamar promenade at San Antonio, looking along the fishing harbour to the seafront and the hills of the town
verification_note: Taken from the railed promenade at right, looking across moored fishing boats to the rock revetment, the seafront buildings and the hillside town. People on the promenade are mid-distance and not in close-up. Older compact-camera file, slightly hazy.
